Anant Singh MLA Update : bihar vidhanasbha ka shitkalin satr 30 navanbar se shuru hone ja raha hai. satr ki taiyariyon ko lekar vidhanasbha men aham baithak huee... is bich mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ki vidhayki ko lekar vidhanasbha adhyaksh ka bara bayan samne aaya hai... vidhanasbha adhyaksh ne bataya ki anant sinh ne apni beti ki shadi ko lekar samay manga hai... unka paksh sunne ke bad hi is mamle men phaisla liya jaega... spikar ne spasht kiya ki pure mamle men vidhi sammat nirnay hoga
